category_tips.biology: 结果区放代表性图（WB/IF/统计图占位）；方法区放流程图；n 值和统计标注
category_tips.medicine: 临床研究标伦理审批号占位；CONSORT 流程图；患者基线表占位
category_tips.chemistry: 合成路线图占位；NMR/MS 谱图占位；产率表格
category_tips.physics: 实验装置图占位；数据拟合曲线；误差棒标注
category_tips.engineering: 系统架构图占位；性能对比表；基准测试结果
category_tips.math: 定理证明框架；关键引理框；公式排版用 LaTeX 风格

examples: Academic conference poster, vertical 2:3 layout, A0 print-ready. Header with bilingual title: 基于深度学习的蛋白质结构预测 (Deep Learning-Based Protein Structure Prediction), authors and affiliations. Body in 4 columns: Introduction (背景与意义), Methods (方法 - network architecture diagram), Results (结果 - 3 figure placeholders with captions), Conclusion (结论与展望). Section headers bold uppercase, figure captions italic. Primary color #1e40af with neutral grays. Clean academic style. 4K.

Modern flat academic poster, figure-dominant. Large hero figure at top showing mechanism diagram. Three infographic-style result panels with big numbers and icons. Minimal text callouts. Bilingual labels throughout. Vibrant but professional palette #0891b2 / #f59e0b. 4K, conference poster.

Bilingual dual-column academic poster, Chinese left column and English right column mirroring content. IMRaD structure. Header with bilingual title. Methods flowchart, results with figure placeholders, conclusion summary box. Institutional palette #1e40af. A1 print-ready. 4K.
accuracy_tips: IMRaD 结构完整（Introduction/Methods/Results/Conclusion）；双语标题中英文一致；图表占位框带 caption；不虚构实验数据或结果；伦理审批/基金号用占位符 [IRB No. XXX]；统计显著性用 */**/***；作者机构用占位符。
